Axis.description:
How a split lays out its two children: `horizontal` puts them side by side,
`vertical` stacks them.

tile.description: A browser tile; defaults to the focused tile.

oneOf.description: Liveness check; replies `pong`.
The whole object model; replies `session`.
Opens a window with one empty workspace.
Records a window's frame after the user moves or resizes it.
Every window; replies `windows`.
Workspaces of one window, or of all windows; replies `workspaces`.
Records the herdr workspace backing a workspace. Sent by the herdr adapter.
Tabs of one workspace, or of all workspaces; replies `tabs`.
Opens a tab with one tile (a terminal unless `content` says otherwise).
Lists tiles; replies `tiles`.
One tile; replies `tile`.

Closes a tile. A terminal's herdr pane is detached, not killed, unless
`kill` is set (F14).
Sets or clears a tile's title.
Points a browser tile at `url`; the shell loads it on `tile.updated`.
Shows `path` in a preview tile.

A preview tile's rendered content; replies `preview`. Shells call it
when they create a preview view; later changes arrive as
`preview.updated` events.
The focused tab's layout; emits `layout.changed` and replies `layout`.
Splits a tile and opens a new one beside it, which takes focus.
Moves focus to the neighbouring tile.
Swaps a tile with its neighbour in `direction`, or with tile `with`.
Moves a tile one step: into its neighbour's slot, or to the tab's edge.
Moves a tile's edge in `direction` by `amount` (negative shrinks).
Zooms a tile to fill its tab; leave `zoomed` out to toggle.

Opens a tile at the end of the tab's stack, whichever tile has focus; a
lone tile becomes master | stack. Evens out the stack afterwards.
Swaps a tile with its tab's master; focus stays on the tile.
Toggles master on the left ↔ master on top, keeping the stack's order.
Gives every tile in the tab's stack the same size.
Records the herdr pane a terminal tile views. Sent by the herdr adapter.

Reads a terminal's screen or history; replies `text`. History lives in
herdr, not in the tile (ADR 0005).
Scrolls a terminal's view; replies `scroll`. 0 is the live bottom.

Finds lines containing `query` in a terminal's history; replies
`matches`. Runs over `recent_unwrapped` output in the core.

Created.description: IDs of what a command created; only the relevant fields are set.

oneOf.description: The request wasn't valid JSON.
Valid JSON, but not a request (e.g. no `method`).
A window, workspace, tab or tile doesn't exist.
The command doesn't apply right now (nothing focused, no neighbour that way…).
Not available in this build or configuration.
A service the command needs (herdr) isn't reachable right now.

Event.description: Something that changed in the core.

oneOf.description: Name, cwd or herdr binding changed.
A window's workspaces changed order.
A workspace's tabs changed order.
A tile's title or content changed (e.g. a terminal got its herdr pane).

A tile closed. `kill` asks the herdr adapter to kill the terminal's pane
rather than detach from it.
A tab's tree, focused tile or zoom changed.
The focused window, workspace, tab or tile changed.

A preview tile's file was (re)rendered: on open, on restore and after
every change on disk. Not saved; `preview.get` returns the latest.

Focus.description: Where the user's focus is. Inner fields are `None` when that level is empty.

Frame.description: A window's frame on screen, in points, origin top left of the main display.

HerdrRef.description:
The herdr pane a terminal tile views. Both IDs are kept: herdr changes a
pane's ID when it moves to another workspace, while the terminal ID is what
`herdr terminal attach` takes. The tab ID matters because closing a herdr
tab reports only the tab, and herdr keeps pane and tab IDs (but not the
process) across a server restart.

amount.description: Share of the enclosing split to move the edge by. Defaults to 0.05.

content.description: The new tile; defaults to a terminal.

direction.description: Which side of `tile` the new tile goes.

tile.description: The tile to split; defaults to the focused one.

content.description: The new tile; defaults to a terminal.

LayoutState.description: A tab's layout, as `layout.changed` and `layout.get` report it.

direction.description: Swap with the neighbour this way. Give exactly one of `direction`, `with`.

with.description: Swap with this tile, which must be in the same tab.

Node.description: One node of a layout tree.

ratio.description: Share of the space given to `a`, in (0, 1).

html.description:
A complete HTML document for the tile's webview; absent for native
kinds. When the tile already shows `path`, pass it to
`azulejoPreview.swap(html)` (shared/webview/preview.js) to keep the
scroll position.

revision.description:
Counts renders of this tile in this run, so a shell can drop stale
updates.

truncated.description: Only the start of a very large file was rendered.

oneOf.description:
Native kinds: the shell shows `path` with QuickLook (macOS) or GTK
(Linux); there's no `html`.
The rest get an explanatory `html` page.

tile.description: A preview tile; defaults to the focused tile.

oneOf.description: The visible screen.
Recent output, soft-wrapped as on screen.
Recent output with soft wraps joined, for log-like text.
Done; nothing to return.
IDs of what the command created.
Where a terminal's view sits after `terminal.scroll`.
A preview tile's content, from `preview.get`.
Lines that matched `terminal.search`.

truncated.description: herdr cut the history short; older lines weren't searched.

line.description: 0-based line in the searched history, oldest first.

detached_herdr.description:
herdr panes whose tiles were closed here. Adoption skips them, so a
closed (detached) tile doesn't come back on the next relaunch. Pruned
once herdr no longer has the pane.

focused_window.description: `None` exactly when there are no windows.

Tab.description:
A tab: one layout tree. A tab always holds at least one tile; closing its
last tile closes the tab.

tiles.description: The tiles in `root`, in no particular order.

zoomed.description: A zoomed tile fills the tab until unzoomed.

content.description: The tab's first tile; defaults to a terminal.

workspace.description: Only this workspace's tabs; all when absent.

index.description: New position within its workspace; past the end means last.

TabSummary.description: A tab and where it lives.

offset_from_bottom.description: Lines above the live bottom; 0 returns to it.

lines.description: How many lines of history to search; herdr's default when absent.

keys.description: Key names in herdr's notation, e.g. `enter`, `ctrl+c`, `up`.

command.description: Command to run instead of the user's shell.

cwd.description: Working directory for a new pane.

ended.description:
The herdr pane is gone (closed elsewhere, or lost with its server).
The shell offers Respawn or Close; binding a new pane clears it.

herdr.description: Set once the herdr adapter has created or adopted a pane.

kill.description: Kill the terminal's herdr pane instead of detaching from it.

TileContent.description: A tile's content and its kind-specific state.

frame.description: Last known screen frame, in points; restored on relaunch.

workspace_name.description: Name of the window's first workspace.
